items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: when I was with Red Allen, they had, had Red Allen, they had John Casmy, myself, old man Glenny, and a fella by the name of Lucci used to play trombone.

ctx.x: We ought to go by that sometime. Yeah. And see the people that worked there. I know several people that worked there. Well, anyway, uh, back to you, to yourself. How did you get started in music?
Well, Sue this kid here, Red Allen, me and him used to be an old friend. So, I kept that thing back there for a souvenir. That was the first, first old guitar we bought for five dollars.

items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: When Red Island did, he had on low short pants.

ctx.x: When Red Island did, he had on low short pants.
Yeah, Willie was a strong man, on the play. John Cappie was strong going clarinet, too.
